entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.17.5
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **SigMod missions run again on a Linux or Docker server after the 2026-10-02 TF2 update.** The update changed how the game stores its key and value data, and the SigMod build the server used crashed it on every start. The server now installs a SigMod rebuilt for the new game. SigMod on a Windows server still crashes on this TF2 update: leave SigMod missions out of the run there until a Windows build follows. - **A run generated with v1.11 to v1.13 keeps going on this release.** The server refused it at connect, so updating meant losing the run. It now plays it with the options it was generated with, and every check counts. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(sigmod): a Linux build for the 2026-10-02 TF2 update by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/175 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.17.4...v1.17.5 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ODY3MDY0NThjYjQyODVhMWE2NGI5YmQwOWU3OTJhNDI6MTc5MDkzOTYzNQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZjJmNDBjNTllOGE4MWI3NjM2M2ZiMjg2YjUyZmJjNDc6MTc5MDkzOTYzOA==/detection)

entry.title: CrossCode v0.10.0rc2
entry.content:
## Fixes to Mod
* Fixed a packaging issue where certain files would not be included, causing the world to fail to load (@buanjautista, #108)
## Changes to Logic
* Renamed all regions to more readable names and split regions into more granular chunks reflecting their actual location (@Valkhiya, #107) * This will also improve the user experience for the small minority of worlds that use region names for hints.
## Fixes to Logic
* Fixed many logic issues discovered while changing regions (@Valkhiya, #107) * **Ba'kii Kum Shade Statue** no longer requires **Maroon Cave Pass**. * **Encrypted Key: A Switch in Altitude** was moved to fall from rise. * **Crocus Pocus** moved to harbor from rise. * **The Observatory** moved to rise from wasteland. * **Heating the Hermit** moved to bergen from of mine.1, now requires mine.2 as condition (mine.1 doesn't contain carritrichs). * **Building a Base** moved to bergen from mine.1, now requires mine.4 as condition instead of heat (bringing it in line with egg pot botanics region). * **Raising the Steaks** now required garden.mid access instead of garden (garden doesn't contain bee hives). * Observatory goal moved to rise from harbor * Facility X goal moved to ridge from ridge.north * Added bidirectional region connectors (@Valkhiya, #107) * Passage from trail to valley now requires green leaf and blue ice instead of just blue ice * Passage from fall to garden now requires red flame and green seed instead of just green seed * Passage from fall to ridge now requires red flame and star instead of just star

entry.title: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 v0.3.0
entry.content:
### New
- **Map helper (`map_helper`, on by default).** The Dragon Universe map shows everything the current chapter has to offer, so you can find your checks without a guide. Each point has a marker in the world and a coloured dot on the overview map: red for fights, green for talk scenes, and so on. Second-playthrough and level-locked points are shown too, which adds 28 fights as checks. - A saga is split into chapters. A **purple** marker opens the next chapter, a **pink** one the previous; a **white** marker goes to the next saga and a **grey** one back to the last. Each needs X and plays the real scene. - By default the next-chapter and next-saga markers appear once you win the fight that opens them. `map_free_travel` makes them always available. - Turning `map_helper` off also turns Saga locks and Interactsanity off. - A story's ending no longer rolls credits the moment you win its last fight. It waits behind a white marker, so you can finish the rest of the map first. - **Item names on the map (`map_item_labels`).** Hovering over a point shows the Archipelago item waiting there and who it is for, coloured by importance: plum for progression, blue for useful, cyan for filler, salmon for traps. - **Item names in the Skill Shop (`shop_item_labels`).** The shop list shows what each capsule sends, coloured the same way. - **Saga locks (`saga_locks`, on by default).** The Frieza, Cell and Buu sagas each need a `Saga Unlock` item before any character can move on to them. The saga a character starts in is always open. The three items can turn up in any order; a saga needs every unlock up to it. - **Interactsanity (`interactsanity`: off / items / talks / both, default both).** Visiting map points sends checks: 204 pickups and 312 talk scenes. Locations are named by chapter and place, and pickups say what the spot holds in the normal game, for example `Goku DU - Saiyan Saga - Ch.1 - ??? near East City (Dragon Radar)`. - **Fighter unlocks (`fighter_unlocks`, on by default).** The 27 fighters without a Dragon Universe story (Frieza, Cell, Trunks and the rest) are `Fighter` items, locked in every mode until found. - **Extra skills (`extra_skills`, on by default).** Up to 187 more skill capsules join the item pool: the other fighters' skills and Breakthroughs, fusion forms, and the remaining Dragon Universe character skills. - **Experience items.** Filler now alternates between Zenie and Experience (x1000, x2500, x5000). An item goes to the character you are playing when it arrives, or the next one you play. The level-ups come on the next fight you win, with the usual stat choice. - **`/map on|off`** turns the map helper on or off for the session and shows its state.
### Changed
- **`dragonsanity` is now a choice:** `all` (default) keeps every Dragon Ball and each wish as a check, `wishes` keeps only the wishes, `off` neither. `true` and `false` in an old yaml still work. - **Dragon Ball checks count pickups.** The game hands out a random missing ball, so `Dragon Ball: Goku #1` is now the first ball Goku picks up, whichever it is. - **Dragon Arena appears on the main menu as soon as the ticket arrives.** You no longer have to enter and leave Dragon Universe to make it show.

entry.title: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 v0.3.1
entry.content:
**Black Label is now supported** by everything added in v0.3.0. If you put `map_helper: false` in your yaml to play v0.3.0 on Black Label, you can take it out.
Seeds made with v0.3.0 work with this version.
### New
- **Black Label (CRC `2a4b60eb`)** works with the map helper, saga locks, Interactsanity, the item names on the map and in the Skill Shop, and Dragon Arena appearing on the main menu as soon as the ticket arrives. Greatest Hits (CRC `c97ef0a4`) is unchanged.
### Good to know
- Black Label has no Cooler-route Frieza fight for Goku. Its check, `Goku DU - Frieza Final Form (Cooler Route)`, is sent together with `Goku DU - Frieza Final Form`.

entry.title: Dragon Ball Z Budokai 3 v0.4.0
entry.content:
**⚠️ Existing seeds must be regenerated.** Fight location names changed, so a seed made with v0.3.1 or earlier will not work with this build.
### Changed
- **Fight locations are named by saga and chapter**, like the talk scenes and pickups already were. You can tell where a fight is from its name: - `Goku DU - Raditz` is now `Goku DU - Saiyan Saga - Ch.1 - Raditz` - `Adult Gohan DU - Piccolo` is now `Adult Gohan DU - Buu Saga - Ch.2 - Piccolo`
### Fixed
- **`Teen Gohan DU - Cell Saga - Ch.2 - ??? Talk 1` could not be reached.** It is a hidden spot in the far north-west corner of the map, so small that flying over it never triggered it. With the map helper on it now responds like any other point.
Both game versions are supported, as in v0.3.1: Greatest Hits (CRC `c97ef0a4`) and Black Label (CRC `2a4b60eb`).

## What's new in v0.9.0
- **Early Ragnarok no longer opens later-disc towns.** The world map kept a Disc 3 story value for its doors after every fight; the client now restores the real one, so towns open only when your story reaches them. - **Story-jump guard:** if a scene pushes the story several chapters ahead at once, story checks and the goal are held (reload an earlier save, or `/ff8keepstory`). Save loads are now detected reliably. - **Fixes:** Death x5 / Pain x5 gave the wrong spells; a status-attack junction was wiped while Elemental Defense was locked; drawn magic was taken from Squall; Card Club checks fired mid-dialogue; Monsters Felled counted late; the Magical Lamp works with Diablos owned; fast-travel labels and battle Potions. - **Logic (new seeds):** GF ability prerequisite chains, Tonberries need Key: Centra Ruins, Bika Snowfield Flare #2 needs the Ragnarok, no keys in Ultimecia's Castle. - **New options (off by default):** Enemy Power and AP Multiplier (experimental), Triple Triad Rules (no Random / Open), Triple Triad Rule Checks. - **Tracker 0.15.0:** a toggle per junction and command lock.
v0.8.0 seeds keep working with this client; the logic fixes need a new seed. Full list: [player guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md) and the PR below.
## Install
1. Archipelago **Launcher** → **Install APWorld** → pick `ff8.apworld` (or copy it into `custom_worlds/`), then restart the Launcher. 2. Optional: drop `ff8_ap_tracker.zip` into PopTracker's `packs/` folder. 3. Optional: `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` is a map preset for the [Archipelago Visual Tracker](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) — see **Visual Tracker** below.
### Visual Tracker
`ff8_visual_tracker.zip` pins every FF8 check on clickable world / extras / GF-ability maps inside the Archipelago Visual Tracker client. To use it:
1. Install [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker) (`tracker.apworld`) and [`visualtracker.apworld`](https://github.com/Wakamu/Archipelago/releases/latest) via **Launcher → Install APWorld**, then restart the Launcher. 2. Copy `ff8_visual_tracker.zip` into the `visual_packs/` folder of your Archipelago install (create it next to `custom_worlds/` if missing). Do **not** unzip it. 3. Launcher → **Visual Tracker**, connect to your server/slot; the FF8 preset is picked up automatically.
Visual Tracker support grew out of a community map layout contributed by **caedesender** (Discord) — thank you!
Requires Archipelago 0.6.7+ and *Final Fantasy VIII* Steam 2013 (`FF8_EN.exe`). Setup guide: the **Final Fantasy VIII** page on your WebHost, or the [Player Guide](https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/blob/main/docs/player-guide.md).
## What's Changed * Gil Snatch: remove the 3000 gil floor by @wilsonao in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/7 * Phase 4 options: Enemy Power, AP Multiplier, Triple Triad rules + rule-check toggle by @wilsonao in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/8 * Docs: live test plan (Phase 4 options, Lamp, FH, LP) by @wilsonao in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/9 * Release v0.9.0: early-Ragnarok door fix, story-jump guard, learn-prerequisite logic, Phase 4 options by @wilsonao in https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/pull/10
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wilsonao/ff8_arch/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.17.9
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **A Windows server with SigMod runs again after the second 2026-10-02 TF2 update.** Valve shipped another update the same evening. SigMod for Windows only knows the TF2 build it was made for, so on the new one the server crashed at start, when anybody bought an upgrade (bots included), or when a player inspected a weapon. The launcher now installs a SigMod build made for the new TF2. - **The debug bundle no longer carries your RCON password.** It promised it did not, but the server's crash log repeats its command line, password included, and `server.cfg` sets it. Every text file in the bundle now has the passwords taken out. If you posted a bundle before, change your RCON password in the launcher. - **The first server start after updating the launcher uses the new launcher.** A launcher from before the update, still running in the background, kept its connection to the room, and the server spent that start unable to read what the room had unlocked. The new launcher now closes the old one's connection before the server starts. - **A bot's upgrade the game refused is no longer announced as bought.** The chat and the log said a bot bought an upgrade even when the game turned the purchase down. They now only report the purchases that happened, and the log names the ones the game refused. - **Defender bots no longer take down a busy server in four ways we caught in testing.** A bot leaving in the middle of shopping, a bot asked what it sees before it had finished spawning, a check that treated any bot-controlled player as a robot, and a few route searches with no limit could each crash or freeze the server, most often on missions with many robots. ### Changed - **After a TF2 update, SigMod for Windows switches itself off instead of crashing the server.** Until a launcher release brings a SigMod build for the new TF2, the server runs without it: missions that need SigMod are refused and the run moves on, and the debug bundle says why. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(sigmod): Windows build 20261005 for TF2 build 11076587 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/180 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.17.8...v1.17.9 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/YWU0NmNjZjRiZGFlZjM5ZmQ2ZDMzYjM5M2FiNDZiOGM6MTc5MTA0NDI1Ng==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/MDdmMDc5NjNjMmM4OGExY2ZkMjEyYTRlN2IyMmY1YTM6MTc5MTA0NDI1OA==/detection)

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.0
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **The bots can buy upgrades again, and an existing server gets SourceMod's fix for the upgrade station crash.** The 2026-10-02 TF2 update changed how the game stores the messages the upgrade station sends, and the SourceMod we shipped read them the old way. A player opening the station crashed the server, and the game refused every upgrade a bot asked for. SourceMod 1.12.0-git7255 reads the new layout, and the launcher and the Docker image now upgrade a server that already has an older SourceMod at its next start. Your own edits to SourceMod's configs are kept. We measured the bots: 35 of 35 purchases refused before, 44 bought after, and a player confirmed the station no longer crashes their server. - **The debug bundle stops pointing at the wrong thing when SigMod cannot find the game.** When SigMod was made for the TF2 build your server reports and still finds none of the game's addresses, the game files are usually half updated, and `summary.txt` now says so and tells you to press Repair, which checks every game file on the next start. It used to tell you to compare two version numbers that already matched. And when every bot purchase is refused on a SourceMod that already has the fix, it no longer blames SourceMod. ### Changed - **The debug bundle names the TF2 build the server is running.** It listed every version the launcher installs and not the one they are all built against, which is the version that matters most on the evening TF2 updates. - **The debug bundle says when two of those versions cannot work together.** Above the logs it now names, in plain words, a SigMod built for a different TF2 build, a SourceMod too old for the upgrade station on this one, and a run where the game refused every upgrade the bots tried to buy. It compares what the file already said; it still does not claim to have found your bug. - **The debug bundle stops sending you after a crash dump that does not exist.** When SigMod catches the fault and closes the server itself, Windows writes no dump, and the summary now says so and points at the two stacks SigMod printed into the log instead. When a dump should exist it names the folders it looked in. - **The debug bundle lists what it could not collect.** Two bundles from the same evening held different files and there was no way to tell a missing file from a file that never existed. `collected.txt` in the zip now says which it was, and why. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.0r2
entry.content:
# Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.0: I Can't Think of a Good Subtitle! You Get This Instead! *AHT v2.2 is only compatible with game mod version 20, which is included below (both NTSC + PAL).*
v2.2 contains *way* more than originally planned (sorry for the long changelog...). There's enough left on our to-do list to justify at least a v2.3, though I'm not sure how quick it'll happen. But who are we kidding, I'm scarily addicted to working on AHT...
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ) # Changelog (compared to v2.1.0) ## Most Notable ### Features * The PAL GC version of the game is now supported by the game mod! * The randomized shop system has been moderately redesigned: - `gem_logic` is now `shop_logic` and comes in 2 forms. `ordered` works identically to `gem_logic = true`. `unordered` is a replacement for `gem_logic = false` which avoids all shop items being in sphere 1. `unordered` assumes you will buy items in order, but doesn't restrict you from doing otherwise at your own risk, whereas `ordered` does enforce the order. - Number of shop items is now determined by `shop_item_count` instead of `key_rings`. * The goal system has been heavily expanded. * `auto_corrections` has been expanded to `halt`, `fix_minor`, `fix_major`, and `chaos`. `halt` halts generation on problems. `fix_minor` fixes relatively inconsequential problems. `fix_major` fixes problems with a more notable impact. `chaos` continues generation instead of fixing or halting. * Added support for 5 traps (Spam Call, Reverse Controls, Bounce, Gem Tax, and Damage Sparx)! * You can now teleport across the orbiting platform sections in Cloudy Domain with a button prompt. ### Logic * Added a logical requirement for the critters in Red's boss fight. * The rising statue room in Sunken Ruins now requires Electric Breath to get to anything, instead of only Double Jump. * `RL: Dark Gem in Northeast` now requires the ability to kill the huge robo-gnorcs guarding it. * Fixed a rare math precision error that could make the final shop item never be in logic. * Made a [reference spreadsheet](<https://tinyurl.com/ahtapsheet>) which lists every region and location access rule, to help with troubleshooting. ## Less Notable ### Fixes/Tweaks * `auto_corrections` will now fix or halt if you attempt to generate a seed with no goal, or if you randomize Light Gem door or Gadget costs to be above 90 while `open_world_mode` is `vanilla`. * Fixed a goal bug that hurt Go Mode accuracy and harmed the quality of calculated playthroughs. * Map icons now render as red = unreachable, yellow = reachable, and green = checked. * The pause menu's gem information no longer includes out-of-logic gems (those from Gem Packs/Taxes and Double Gems). * Fixed multiple bugs with how shop unlock items are created and handled logically. * Added location groups for Light Gem doors and gadgets. * In-game notifications now include item sends, and a small Easter egg when you receive specific items from yourself. * `hint_boss_rewards` now hints all boss locations, not just the breath rewards. * `logging_level` is now a single choice of level of detail. * The pause menu's item list now correctly identifies Pole Spin, and "Health Unit+" is no longer missing from it. * Gem count in minigames is no longer separate from your full count, meaning you don't need to finish a minigame to get its gems. ### Misc. * Significantly refactored chunks of the codebase to be better designed and easier to maintain. * Added client command `/costs`. * Nearly every location has been renamed for less verbosity. * "Generics" filler items are now "Shinies". * Added 270 gems from Stormy Beach to the gem logic system that were missed. * Condensed a few YAML options for simplicity. * Locations are now sorted on the tracker page in order of vanilla game levels, then alphabetically by logical region, then alphabetically by location.
